title: Per-surface instructions are not delivered to MCP clients at initialize
wanted_capability: A client connecting on a named MCP surface receives that surface's declared instructions in the initialize result (ServerInfo.instructions), alongside the base server instructions, so the surface's intent is visible without calling a tool.
evidence: src/server/surface.rs ToolSurfaceVerdict::ToolSurface.instructions is parsed from the routing packet
system-defaults/mcp-surfaces/routing.json defines instructions for readonly, agent_internal, interactive, ops, and default surfaces
src/server/handler.rs initialize resolves the surface entry but returns self.get_info(), whose instructions are a fixed server-wide string
src/tools/mcp_surface.rs surface_verdict_summary exposes the text only as a 200-char instructions_preview in bbox_mcp_surface output
design/surfaces/mcp/mcp-surfaces.md open question on where per-surface instructions are exposed
notes: Triage trace: partially stale premise corrected. The field is now read by bbox_mcp_surface (instructions_preview, truncated), but initialize still returns fixed server instructions regardless of surface.
